Doing this locally from SPEC.md. Reading the spec and surveying the repo.Implementing front-matter parsing, the SQLite index, and wiring the APIs.Removing unused imports from `app.js`, then updating helpers and tests.Refactoring long functions to meet the 30-line limit, then re-running tests and committing.Implemented the full SPEC locally and committed as `fe71961`.

**What landed**
- Front matter parsing (`src/front-matter.js`): title/tags, tag normalize (trim/lowercase/dedupe/sort), body without the `---` block
- SQLite index (`src/wiki-index.js`): versioned migrations, FTS5 over title+body, tag table; sync on `createApp()`, update on PUT/DELETE; `app.locals.close()` closes the DB
- Search: AND, case-insensitive, title-weighted ranking, snippets with `**`, punctuation-safe, blank `q` → 400
- Tags: `GET /tags`, `GET /tags/:tag`; page list/detail include `tags`

**Verification:** `npm test` (5 passing) and `npm run build` both succeeded.
